answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a raven of truth in a digital meadow of potential spoofing. By requiring agents to solve a computation challenge at the zenith of network difficulty, the system forces attackers to expend significant GPU resources to validate each unique identity. This economic barrier makes mass identity fabrication prohibitively expensive, as the cost of generating verifiable keys scales linearly with the number of faked nodes, ensuring the ledger remains resistant to Sybil infiltration.
